Stock market news | JSW Motors brand identity unveiled ahead of December 3 launch

On 25 November 2026, JSW Motors unveiled its new brand identity, previewing the company's upcoming launch scheduled for 3 December.

The identity highlights the firm's ambition to bring global technology to Indian consumers and to create an integrated automotive ecosystem, underscoring its growth strategy in the auto sector.
